title: Gapless Parquet forward publication and scheduler ownership
runbook_section: LIVE / Gapless publication and pull contract

external_dependencies.for: The shared parquet_ops core, CLI split and job-executor foundation are integrated. This track receives unfinished forward execution; P5/P6 remain downstream in the old track.

supersedes.postgres_shrink_ingest_repoint_20260825:: Direct forward publication, gap authoring and executor activation move here. PostgreSQL P5/P6 retirement stays in the older track.

note: Give every time-bearing product one durable source owner for forward refresh, repair and coverage status under the stateful executor. Historical completeness does not satisfy this track.
production_authorization: Owner directive 2026-09-02 authorizes an executor-only repository release and eventual controlled removal of the six inventoried Railway writer objects. Feature-branch activation/removal remains forbidden. After merge, the exact main executor deployment must reach SUCCESS and the orchestration task must explicitly resume the production handoff before any fencing, activation, or service deletion.

shared_writes: pipeline/direct/ and pipeline/parquet/lane_registry.py are serialized registries with one owner at a time; p0a is the sole interface/cli/data.py owner for the availability bootstrap, and p5 depends transitively on p0a without editing that file.
gapless p0a owns the availability schema/publisher/bootstrap; reader r2 may consume the frozen artifact only after p0a lands.
Job-executor registry and schedule changes land only after all source-family writers are registered and reviewed.
Legacy and executor writers for the same source/product may never overlap.
tripwires: No PostgreSQL or R2 data deletion and no retirement migration.
A governed absence is not zero rows, a failed job, an unsettled source or an unrun day.
Every required rung closes before the product-day is terminal.
A source handoff pauses and proves the old owner inactive before activating the new owner.
The 2026-09-02 owner directive rejects Railway cron scheduling. Activation/removal waits for merge, exact main executor SUCCESS, an explicit orchestration follow-up, and no-in-flight proof.
Rollback disables an executor lane and preserves data/manifests/checkpoints; it never restores cronSchedule, reconnects, redeploys, or recreates a Railway cron service.
Tail repair is bounded, checkpointed and idempotent; it never rewrites a valid immutable day.
Availability bootstrap may scan verified history once; API and slider requests may never list historical lane objects or invoke that census.
A terminal day becomes selectable only after the immutable availability generation is verified and its checksum-bound pointer advances last.

slices.task: Inventory every time-bearing product: provider, floor, ceiling, lag, cadence, rungs, current/legacy owner, terminal states and observed tail. Freeze the source-ceiling and governed-absence contract.
slices.remaining: Fresh production R2 ladder census and receipt-derived provider floors/ceilings/lags remain unmeasured; no write is authorized.

slices.task: Implement the canonical availability Parquet schema/publisher and idempotent one-time bootstrap. Bind the immutable bootstrap receipt, source inventory root and authoritative required-rung set; publish immutable content-addressed generations and advance a checksum-bound pointer last; prove pointer races, corrections, governed absences, all-rung intersection and fail-closed reads.
slices.remaining: Offline implementation and review are complete. No production bootstrap ran. Before the first separately authorized apply, drain or restart every pre-barrier writer process; production R2 bootstrap and the HTTP/tRPC/TypeScript reader cutover remain separately authorized dependent sessions.

slices.task: Implement durable forward writers for climate products, prioritizing the 94-day solar tail and the 27-day temperature/dew/precipitation/humidity/wind tails.
Implement durable forward writers for NASA POWER wetness and ERA5-Land moisture/temperature/VPD products, preserving product-specific precedence and all-rung publication.
Reconcile event/observation forward owners for fire, water, vegetation, weather, sensors and other active lanes; eliminate ownership ambiguity without stopping a healthy writer prematurely.
Author idempotent missing-day work and bounded tail repair; close every owed day as published or governed absent at every required rung.

Make the stateful job executor the sole scheduler and durable invocation owner; prove the six-service responsibility matrix, cadence/source-ceiling parity, restart/catch-up, no-overlap, leases/checkpoints/retries/dead letters, retire tracked cron configs, and stage the controlled post-main service-object removal.
Observe at least three consecutive scheduled advancements per activated product, exercise retry/restart/expired-lease recovery, and publish exact coverage/inventory reconciliation.

orchestration_wave1_20260902.rule: shared working tree, disjoint write sets per slice, no builds/tests inside slices, one orchestrator sweep at the join
